response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS amount_average, AVG(t.balance) AS balance_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(amount_average) AS average_amount, AVG(balance_average) AS average_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_region_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.average_amount, r.average_balance, r.average_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS amount_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL
